subject.title: Dashboard: shared vs private tabs + role/scope-gated visibility

question: Should shared/private dashboard tabs be implemented as bundled dashboard work, and what security boundary should `visibility` or `scope` promise?
rationale: The request crosses Control UI, operator scopes, persistent dashboard state, and privacy expectations; automation cannot decide whether this is only UI filtering or a stronger authorization boundary.

options.title: Keep As Roadmap Subissue
options.body: Keep this open until the dashboard base is settled, then implement tab visibility with explicit store enforcement, migration behavior, and security proof.

options.title: Fold Into The Tracker
options.body: Close this only if maintainers want the Wave 2+ roadmap tracker to own all Tier 3 dashboard planning without separate subissues.

options.title: Move Outside Bundled Work
options.body: Defer bundled implementation and ask for an external plugin or ClawHub package if maintainers do not want multi-user dashboard semantics in core-distributed surfaces.

recommendation.title: Keep As Roadmap Subissue
recommendation.body: Keep this open until the dashboard base is settled, then implement tab visibility with explicit store enforcement, migration behavior, and security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest current-main seam and product/security precedent for native Control UI plugin tabs.
